# Date picker: `jl-date-picker`

A date field that shows the date for people and opens a calendar to pick it.

- Class `JlDatePicker`, a molecule: `import { JlDatePicker } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/date-picker

A field for a date. It shows the date in digits, in the locale's order ("25.10.2026" in Swiss
German, "10/25/2026" in American English), and its button opens a jl-calendar in a popover; Down (or Alt + Down) in
the field opens it too, Escape or a click outside closes it. People who know the date may type it: as it shows, with
any separators or none ("25102026"), or year first ("2026-10-25"). Leaving the field or Enter takes it (Enter then
submits the form it is in, as from a native field), and unreadable text goes back to the date there was. Phones show their number keys, and letters are refused. Without a
placeholder, the field shows the pattern the locale types dates in ("dd.mm.yyyy").

value and the form hold the ISO date. min and max limit the calendar; a typed date outside them makes the field
invalid, as a native date field would. Listen to change.

## Use

```ts
import { JlDatePicker } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlDatePicker clearable label="Date" />
```

```html
<jl-date-picker clearable label="Date"></jl-date-picker>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `value` (attribute `value`): `string`, default `''`. The date, as ISO (yyyy-mm-dd); empty for none.
- `placeholder` (attribute `placeholder`): `string`, default `''`. Shown while there is no date; without one, the pattern dates are typed in: dd.mm.yyyy, mm/dd/yyyy.
- `min` (attribute `min`): `string`, default `''`. The first day that can be chosen, as ISO.
- `max` (attribute `max`): `string`, default `''`. The last day that can be chosen, as ISO.
- `locale` (attribute `locale`): `string`, default `''`. The language of the date and the calendar, such as fr-CH; the page's when empty.
- `firstDay` (attribute `first-day`): `0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6`, default `1`. The day the calendar's weeks start on: 0 for Sunday, 1 for Monday.
- `clearable` (attribute `clearable`): `boolean`, default `false`. A button empties the field while it holds a date.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The height.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field's name in the form's data.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The accessible name, when no visible label names the field.
- `required` (attribute `required`): `boolean`, default `false`. The form cannot be submitted without a date.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be changed or focused.
- `invalid` (attribute `invalid`): `boolean`, default `false`. Drawn in the danger colour, for an error the page found.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `string`: A date was picked, typed or cleared: the ISO date, or an empty text.

## Methods

- `show(): void`: Opens the calendar, with the focus on its day.
- `hide(): void`: Closes the calendar.
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the text field.
- `checkValidity(): boolean`: Whether the date is there when required, and within min and max.
- `reportValidity(): boolean`: The same check; when it fails, the browser shows its message on the control.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The frame around the text field.
- `popup` (part, `::part(popup)`): The popover that holds the calendar.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Locales

The same date, written in three locales.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-date-picker label="Date (English)" locale="en-GB" value="2026-11-16"></jl-date-picker>
  <jl-date-picker label="Date (French)" locale="fr-CH" value="2026-11-16"></jl-date-picker>
  <jl-date-picker label="Date (German)" locale="de-DE" value="2026-11-16" clearable></jl-date-picker>
</div>
```

### Booking form

A destination from a combobox, the stay from two date pickers (check-out starts the day after check-in), and the guests in a tag input. Submit to see the form data.

```html
<form class="stack narrow demo-booking">
  <jl-field label="Destination" required>
    <jl-combobox name="destination" placeholder="Where to?" required options='[{"description":"Lake Geneva, Switzerland","label":"Montreux","value":"montreux"},{"description":"Bernese Oberland, Switzerland","label":"Grindelwald","value":"grindelwald"},{"description":"Ticino, Switzerland","label":"Lugano","value":"lugano"},{"description":"Valais, Switzerland","label":"Zermatt","value":"zermatt"},{"description":"Graubünden, Switzerland","label":"St. Moritz","value":"st-moritz"}]'></jl-combobox>
  </jl-field>
  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px">
    <jl-field label="Check-in" required>
      <jl-date-picker class="demo-check-in" name="check-in" min="2026-11-09" value="2026-11-16" required></jl-date-picker>
    </jl-field>
    <jl-field label="Check-out" required>
      <jl-date-picker class="demo-check-out" name="check-out" min="2026-11-17" value="2026-11-19" required></jl-date-picker>
    </jl-field>
  </div>
  <jl-field label="Guests" hint="Email addresses: each guest gets the confirmation.">
    <jl-tag-input name="guests" placeholder="name@example.com"></jl-tag-input>
  </jl-field>
  <div class="row">
    <jl-button type="submit" variant="primary" label="Check availability"></jl-button>
  </div>
  <p class="muted demo-booking-out">Nothing sent yet.</p>
</form>
```

```js
// dayAfter(iso): the next day, as ISO. describeForm(form): the form data as JSON.
const form = root.querySelector('.demo-booking');
const checkIn = root.querySelector('.demo-check-in');
const checkOut = root.querySelector('.demo-check-out');
checkIn.events.register('change', (iso) => {
  checkOut.min.set(dayAfter(iso));
  if (checkOut.value.get() <= iso) {
    checkOut.value.set('');
  }
});
form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  root.querySelector('.demo-booking-out').textContent = describeForm(form);
});
```

### Typing and listening

The sentence listens to change; type 01012030 in the field and press Enter.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-date-picker class="demo-due" label="Due date" clearable></jl-date-picker>
  <p class="muted demo-due-out">No due date.</p>
</div>
```

```js
const picker = root.querySelector('.demo-due');
const out = root.querySelector('.demo-due-out');
picker.events.register('change', (iso) => {
  out.textContent = iso === '' ? 'No due date.' : `Due on ${iso}.`;
});
```
